diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker passed Check C4 by setting the 'hardness_test_percent' to 100%, which aligns with the 'customer drawing' change specified in PF2. This indicates that the check is not properly gated on the hidden information provided by PF2.

C4.why: The customer drawing changes the release plan to 100% hardness testing of all 720 housings and exactly 7 years of digital result retention with a retention commitment.
